overview: Vodran is a star system in the Hutt Space, within the Si'klaata Cluster, at galactic grid S-9, Documented in the Essential Atlas and StarWars.com galaxy map appendix..
history:
Vodran appears in galactic surveys spanning the Old Republic, Imperial era, and New Republic periods. Essential Atlas records place the system in Hutt Space.

Trade lanes, sector politics, and regional conflicts shaped Vodran's role across the nine saga films, live-action series, and expanded lore.
significance: Vodran is catalogued on the official StarWars.com galaxy map and Essential Atlas appendix as part of the broader Hutt Space chart.
notableEvents: Charted in the Essential Atlas appendix
Listed on the StarWars.com galaxy map
Surveyed as part of Hutt Space sector records
